description: This file defines the DefaultExceptionHtmlSubscriber class, which handles rendering default HTML error pages for various HTTP errors (4xx series) within Drupal, by making subrequests to generate appropriate error responses.

classes.name: DefaultExceptionHtmlSubscriber
classes.description: Handles core default HTML error pages by intercepting exceptions and generating appropriate responses through subrequests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies: HTTP kernel, logger, redirect destination, and access-unaware router.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the subscriber, set very low (-128) to ensure it fires after custom handlers.

methods.name: getHandledFormats
methods.description: Specifies that this subscriber handles 'html' format responses.

methods.name: on4xx
methods.description: Handles 4xx HTTP errors by making a subrequest if the error status code is greater than 400.

methods.name: on401
methods.description: Handles 401 Unauthorized errors by making a subrequest to '/system/401'.

methods.name: on403
methods.description: Handles 403 Forbidden errors by making a subrequest to '/system/403'.

methods.name: on404
methods.description: Handles 404 Not Found errors by making a subrequest to '/system/404'.

methods.name: makeSubrequest
methods.description: Creates and handles a subrequest to generate the error page response, with error handling and caching considerations.
